findings.description: PolicyGuard rejection on missing data is safety-critical fail-closed behavior. 'SHOULD' is advisory and allows compliant implementations to skip the guard; this must be 'MUST' to be enforceable.

evidence.quote: PolicyGuard SHOULD reject when data is missing.

findings.proposed_fix: Replace 'SHOULD' with 'MUST': "PolicyGuard MUST reject when data is missing."
